Official upstream release feeds changed. This PR records unreviewed candidates only; it does not modify approved engine locks, apply patches, build engines, or publish a trusted release.

Promotion requires patch rebase review, cold source-build evidence, native browser and automation suites, dependency/license/security review, and user-approved release promotion. Engine pinning and active sessions must be preserved. The 6-hour schedule can be delayed and is not an update SLA.
